prompts: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise technical diagram for a Chinese mathematics and optimization blog. Landscape 3:2, white background, thin rounded outlines, generous whitespace, restrained pastel blue inputs, purple matrix operations, green scaled update, orange parameter update. Large clean sans-serif English labels, no watermark, no decorative robot, no application imagery. Title exactly: "Muon: from gradients to parameter updates". Main horizontal flow has five clear cards: "Aggregated gradient G" -> "Momentum M" with small subtitle "Nesterov optional" -> "Normalize + Newton-Schulz" with subtitle "Transform update spectrum" -> "Shape / RMS scaling" -> "Learning-rate step". Arrows must connect only adjacent cards. Under the final step, show a separate short orange branch from a box "Old weights W" through a box "Decoupled weight decay" into a final box "Updated weights". The output from "Learning-rate step" also enters "Updated weights" as a separate contribution. Do not imply decay is passed through the spectral transform. Put a clear small heading above the main lane: "Selected dense linear matrices". Along the bottom, a visually separate gray note panel says "Embeddings, output heads and vectors: separate AdamW group"; no arrow from this note into the Muon transform. A final concise footer says "Orthogonalize the update direction, not the weights". No singular-value numbers or empirical results. The image must make clear that the global gradient is aggregated before the nonlinear matrix transform, and that shape scaling and learning rate are later operations. All labels should remain inside their cards with generous padding.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one polished technical infographic for a Chinese optimization blog. Landscape 3:2 composition. White background, thin rounded outlines, pastel blue for data/batch, purple for statistics, orange for update clocks, green for comparisons. Large clean English sans-serif labels, generous spacing, no watermark, no application imagery. Title exactly: "Batch size changes more than the learning rate". At top center one large blue card: "Global effective batch B". Three distinct arrows fan down from this card to three separate rounded panels arranged horizontally. Left purple panel title "Gradient statistics", with two short lines "Noise covariance" and "Signal alignment". Middle orange panel title "Updates per data budget", with two lines "N / B optimizer steps" and "Warmup and decay schedule". Right green panel title "Memory and shrinkage", with two lines "Momentum in data units" and "Cumulative weight decay". From EACH of the three panels a separate arrow leads into ONE wide neutral bottom card labeled "Compare at the same samples / tokens" and a smaller line "Choose LR, momentum and decay together". Final small footer below: "Scaling laws require explicit assumptions". This is conceptual dataflow, not a measured chart. Do not draw a universal upward arrow for the optimal learning rate. Do not equate microbatch size with global batch size. Avoid formulas other than the specified N / B and letters B and N. Ensure every arrow endpoint lands on a panel boundary and no arrows cross text.
update_flow_edit: Edit this technical diagram, keeping its overall white/pastel style, rounded cards, lane layout and exact arrow connections. Crucial correction: DELETE EVERY mathematical equation in the image. Do not add any new mathematical notation, normalization formula, summation or numeric factor. This is a verbal process diagram only. The allowed text is exactly: title 'Muon: from gradients to parameter updates'; lane heading 'Selected dense linear matrices'; first card 'Aggregated gradient' with subtitle 'Correct global weighting'; second card 'Momentum' with subtitle 'Nesterov optional'; third card 'Normalize + Newton-Schulz' with subtitle 'Transform update spectrum'; fourth card 'Shape / RMS scaling' with subtitle 'Choose a convention'; fifth card 'Learning-rate step'; lower left card 'Old weights'; lower middle card 'Decoupled weight decay'; lower right card 'Updated weights'; bottom note 'Embeddings, output heads and vectors: separate AdamW group'; footer 'Orthogonalize the update direction, not the weights'. All equations currently below these card headings must be removed, including the summation, momentum equation, normalization fractions, delta W equation, decay equation and final weight equation. Reflow card text with generous whitespace. Keep the gradient -> momentum -> transform -> scaling -> learning-rate arrows. Keep Old weights -> Decoupled weight decay -> Updated weights and the separate arrow from Learning-rate step into Updated weights. No extra text and no equations.
